reviews.text: I have known Jen for over 12 years as she has groomed my granddogs and now Teddy, my Australian Labradoodle.  She treats us like family and Ted get compliments everywhere he goes on his gorgeous haircut!

Jen is amazing! Goes above and beyond what  we even ask of.  My puppy can be work, and grooming isn’t his fav but when we get to her front door he is sooo excited to be back! The love she gives him is beyond words and I am so blessed to have someone I can trust. 🥰 …
Thank you Sue! I appreciate you guys!
My dog has been seeing Jen for 3 years. She is WONDERFUL! She is so gentle and attentive to Sasha. I wouldn't take her to anyone else!

She seemed nice when I heard her bathing the dog but I was there for 55 minutes and nobody greeted me I hollered out four times. I figured that was pretty rude and decided just to leave and to go to a different groomer. Weird too because the doorbell is extremely loud. Maybe just a bad day but you did waste an hour of my time.

Shoutout to my dog’s groomer 🐾

You always make my dog look great and I really appreciate the care you put into your work. It means a lot knowing my pup is in good hands. Thanks for always doing an awesome job. 🐶

Jen is by far the best pup groomer ever. She is always super sweet and honest and speedy! My pup Tater is always a happy camper after he leaves her! Will never have another groomer I go to! 10 stars ⭐️ amazing!

Jen has been our pups groomer for years and we are so thankful - not only for the perfect grooming but her incredible patience😅. She gets to know each of her clients🐶 personalities and shares so much love.They come out looking perfectly trimmed, brushed and smelling so clean! Highly recommend Jen at Just Stylin’ Pet Grooming!
This was our first time at Just Stylin' and we'll definitely be back. The staff was very nice and professional. My dog Leo came out looking great. I have no complaints!

Jennifer was so great with our dogs! Even Salvatore, who can be 'iffy' with people, allowed her to immediately pet him. Foxy had the cutest little haircut, and came out with little Halloween bows in her fur.🦊🎃Salvatore had a little Halloween bandana on after his bath.🐶🎃Their nails were nicely trimmed and filed neatly. All done relatively quickly and for a very fair price. The shampoo used smelled way better than the last place we took them to. It was nice and natural smelling, not harsh at all. I also could see that she used clear barriers to contain them after the groom, because we could see Foxy waiting in the window behind the clear barrier, and didn't look like she was in distresss in a small cage awaiting pick up, so thank you for that. I would absolutely recommend Just Stylin' Pet Grooming, and will be going here from now on. I feel like with our previous groomer closing up shop unexpectedly, the silver lining was finding Jennifer.
Jennifer is absolutely amazing,she took my pug in at the last minute and did a fabulous job! You will not be disappointed with her handling and beautifying your fur baby.
Great experience grooming all three of my dogs. Very quick, accommodating and friendly service.

Jennifer Sullins did a great job with my senior dog!  My dog Olive is 14 and cannot see or hear well.  She was recently scared by a mobile groomer with a very loud dryer.  I have been looking for months for someone I could trust.  I even resorted to grooming her myself with very bad results.  My friend recommended Jennifer who has been her groomer for over 10 years.  Jennifer is very gentle and worked very hard to make my pup feel safe.  Olive looked great afterward and happy.  Lastly her prices were reasonable especially after trying a mobile groomer.  Give Jennifer a try.  You won’t be sorry.  Your welcome!

Jen is the only groomer our pup has ever known.  :)  It's been almost 11 years now and from the beginning she has always treated him as if he was her own.  He's not a fan of car rides or new places and when he gets to Jen, he's usually shaking and a nervous wreck.  She is so kind, gentle and loving with him.  And he looks (and smells) fabulous when he is done!!!
I am totally pleased with the job she did with my little Poppy. I will definitely be using her again.

Jen is a gem! We’ve been taking our dogs to her for years and they’re always happy to go. My shy one marches right in and covers her with kisses! She’s wonderful with all of them but especially our senior pup who has special needs. He can be a spicy little fella, especially so now in his old age, but Jen has a way with him. She always approaches her work with good humor and grace. We highly recommend her services and we greatly appreciate all that she does to keep our fur babies looking and feeling good. We never worry about them when they’re in her care. Thanks so much for all you do Jen!
Jenn is the absolute best ❤️
They do a great job and they very nice and respectful

Jen is absolutely amazing! She’s been grooming, our sheep a doodle for a long time and also used to groom our shorkie before she went to doggie heaven! Hands down the best you will find and also an all around amazing human!
Jen is great. My lit'l fur baby just loves her.
My dogs were in need of some serious grooming. Now they're just stylin, thanks to Jen.  They may not always love  getting groomed, but they love Jen and they look great.

Jen is the most amazing groomer we have ever had for our pets! Our little dog is rather temperamental and she knows exactly how to gently handle his quirks and does such a good job with his grooming needs. She also grooms our cat in the cutest lion cut so he doesn’t get matted and stays cool in the summer. Our pets do not mind going to see Jen because of her caring way with them…plus they always look great!!! We highly recommend Jen as the best groomer in the Valley!!!

Jen is the best groomer in town!!! We have gone to her for 6 years, my maltipoo Sammy Joe is always so happy to see her and that is important when finding a good groomer! :) she nails her look every time ! Thanks Jen!

Fantastic grooms, super professional and reasonable pricing! If you are looking for an amazing dog groomer, I highly recommend Jen with Just Stylin' Pet Grooming! We have a mini goldendoodle and Jen has been her groomer for the last 6 years. Our dog is a little difficult and a barker, but Jen takes it in stride and delivers a beautiful groom regardless. Jen was so popular at her previous employer, I had to call weeks in advance to schedule an appointment - she's just that good!
Amazing service and style! My high anxiety large double doodle needs extra care and Jenn never hesitates to provide it. My pup felt safe and secure and looked amazing! See you aging in a few weeks!!
